retrieved.text: To reset your password, open the login page and select "Forgot password". We email a reset link to the address registered on your account, and the link expires after 30 minutes. Support staff cannot see or retrieve your password and will never ask you for it. If you no longer have access to that email address, contact support so we can verify your identity before the email on the account is changed.
retrieved.title: Password reset

retrieved.text: Withdrawals above $2,000, and the first withdrawal to a new bank account, are held for a manual security review. Reviews usually take 1 to 3 business days. Support cannot speed up or skip a review and cannot promise a completion time. You will receive an email when the review is finished.

retrieved.text: To verify your address, upload a utility bill, bank statement or government letter dated within the last 3 months that shows your full name and address. Screenshots, and documents in a name other than the account holder's, are not accepted. Verification usually takes up to 2 business days.
